title: Playwright harness — webapp / docapp
description: Laconic static gate for apps/webapp and apps/docapp. File: apps/<app>/playwright.harness.json. Required Playwright project names: functional, seo, analytics, visual. Mobile variants (functional-mobile, visual-mobile, …) are allowed. playwright.config.ts project `name` values MUST match this list (import or duplicate — keep simple). Narrow integration only: app up, mock externals. No e2e suite names.

projects.description: Playwright config project names. Must include functional, seo, analytics, visual. Optional *-mobile variants OK.

coverage.description: Optional coverage wiring hint. Collect when feasible (nextcov for Next apps); no thresholds yet; report artifacts per project.

thresholds.description: Thresholds are not enforced yet; omit or set false.
